preconditions.description: The input is a list containing exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(b, str) for b in bears)
preconditions.description: Both elements in the input list are strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'black' if set(bears) == {'black'} else return_value == 'brown' if set(bears) == {'brown'} else return_value == 'white' if set(bears) == {'white'} else return_value == 'dark brown' if set(bears) == {'black', 'brown'} else return_value == 'grey' if set(bears) == {'black', 'white'} else return_value == 'light brown' if set(bears) == {'brown', 'white'} else return_value == 'unknown'
postconditions.description: The return value is determined by the set of input bear colors: identical pairs yield the same color; specific mixed pairs yield 'dark brown', 'grey', or 'light brown'; any other combination yields 'unknown'.
